UNIVERSAL 4-VECTOR SYNTHESIS: Never interpret a sign stereotype in isolation. If `steersman_dampened_by_saturn.is_active` or `steersman_in_private_house` is TRUE, you MUST override extroverted stereotypes (like Leo or Aries). 3. MODULATE TONE BASED ON INTENSITY: If the Saturnian dampening is "Extreme" (Orb 0-3°), describe the native as highly guarded and heavily defensive. If it is "Mild" (Orb 6-10°), describe it merely as a healthy background caution or slight hesitation. 4. Output a highly detailed, bulleted report on the "Mechanics of the Chart" combining these vectors. DO NOT interpret deep psychological trauma or the Solar-Lunar blend—leave that to Agent 2.
